vb_textbox.text: Begin by choosing the gnomes at random but pay close attention to the result; i.e. if choosing a brown gnome results in a high number of mushrooms, then remember that and keep that in your mind. The gnomes will only appear in the same pairs each time, eg there is always a yellow and a pink, always an orange and a purple, always a green and a blue. That makes it easier to decide which of the pair is better to pick to get the most mushrooms. Likewise, whenever you pick a gnome and it results in getting no mushrooms, remember to keep note of which colour gnome that is. There seem to be some gnomes that have a higher chance of getting lots of mushrooms. Another tip would be to keep your thumbs on the space bar so that you are always ready to press the space bar to harvest the mushrooms.
